_meta.retrievalMethod: Manufacturer pages fetched via Firecrawl relay. 2026-10-29: Shopify product JSON / verbatim-quote extraction. 2026-10-30: (a) Shopify store product feeds (/products.json) where the description contains a labelled ingredient list; (b) product pages, taking the list under the page's 'Ingredients' label, or the first water/aqua-led list when the label is a separate tab. Bundles, kits, multi-packs, tools and non-hair items excluded; lists recorded verbatim, never corrected. Brands that publish ingredients only as images (e.g. Carol's Daughter, Kinky-Curly) are not included.
_meta.rightsNote: Ingredient lists are factual label declarations. Marketing copy is NOT stored except short excerpts needed for claim-language review of Supernatural's own products.
